Tottenham Hotspur v Crystal Palace (Kick-off 5.30pm). Coverage of the Premier League match at Tottenham Hotspur Stadium. Spurs took the lead in last season's corresponding fixture courtesy of Dominic Solanke, but things soon took a turn for the worse for them when Micky van de Ven was sent off, with Palace going on to win 3-1 thanks to a brace by Ismaila Sarr and a strike from Jorgen Strand Larsen.

Aston Villa v Fulham (Kick-off 8.00pm). Coverage of the Premier League match at Villa Park. The hosts claimed a 3-1 win when the teams met here last term, with Raul Jimenez giving the visitors an early lead, but the Villans fighting back through Ollie Watkins, John McGinn and Emiliano Buendia. They will be expecting another three points this evening against a Fulham side that have found wins hard to come by so far this season.
